answer: The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. One receipt settles the question, and the receipt is Ivory bead maker horn button mark carved within the ivory yard, written as each horn button is a measured tusk yield plus an ivory-carver signature. One pulse is a pass, one copper is a fare, one ferrous is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. One mask pays 62 POA and waits 13 days; a farm pays 25358 POA and still waits 13 days per mask.
